set_aside.subject: replay of an accepted import confirmation in the same owner session
set_aside.text: “A confirmation refused because the closure exists — made by any import accepted before it, of another session or of this one” contradicts “Stage (1) comes first — the session, the CSRF value and the confirmation value, used up when it was carried (A13 rule 6)”
set_aside.question: When the owner resubmits the confirmation that already accepted the import in this same session, is the submission refused at stage (1) because its confirmation value was already used, or as an import permanently refused because the resulting closure exists?
options: Refuse at stage (1) as an already-used confirmation value, without reaching the closure check.
Reach the closure check and refuse because the import is closed, despite the confirmation value having been used.
Define a distinct replay outcome for a confirmation whose own accepted import created the closure.
set_aside.default_guess: Apply the stated check order: refuse at stage (1) because the confirmation value was already used; since the closure exists, do not offer another import confirmation step.

witness.initial: One owner session has an uploaded VPS file and a valid pending import confirmation; no migration closure exists.
events: Registry accepts the import, creates the closure, uses up the confirmation value and drops every uploaded file, but the response is lost.
The owner resubmits the same confirmation form in the same still-valid session.
outcomes: The changed State 4 outcome treats the confirmation as refused because the closure created by this session's earlier accepted import exists, permanently closing the flow.
A13 rule 6 and the changed passage's stage-(1)-first rule refuse it as an already-used confirmation value before the closure is checked.
witness.observer: The owner and the State 5 implementer see different refusal classifications and therefore potentially different response pages or codes.
